summary: Read one runtime by id without reducing every runtime

replay.detail: Existing claims and projections are read unchanged. No replay is required.

schema.detail: Add a local partial SQLite index on textual runtime ids from the same actual-state claims read by the canonical fold. The index is created automatically when the store opens. Claim registry, shared projection layout, schema document, compatibility digest and storage version are unchanged.

rules.detail: Runtime detail and control resolve candidate owners by indexed folded-runtime-id sources, restrict candidates to subjects with a runtime observation at the selected snapshot, then use the existing canonical status reduction. Detail and control lookups run on blocking workers.

compatibility.detail: Runtime resources, unknown-id responses, history and authorization semantics are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The first open builds the local index in one write transaction over retained claims. An isolated 118,390-claim fixture took 1.237 seconds; a linear same-mix estimate for 200,000 claims is 2.090 seconds, not a production measurement. This exceeds the 100 ms write-transaction target and is an open intake point. Later opens reuse the index.

recovery.detail: Older binaries can read the unchanged claims without recovery.
